title: Giants’ Jaxson Dart set for season-ending surgery after serious knee injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants’ Jaxson Dart set for season-ending surgery after serious knee injury
sources.description: New York Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart is expected to undergo knee surgery that will end his 2026 season after suffering damage to his MCL, PCL and meniscus in Monday night’s loss to the Los Angeles Rams, according to reports Wednesday. NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo reported that the surgery is expected to lead to a full recovery. ESPN’s Adam Schefter reported that the damage to Dart’s left knee included his MCL, PCL and meniscus, with the meniscus considered the main issue.
